messages:
Ravi: alert: restore for customer:88 failed with KMS Decrypt denied at 03:14 UTC :rotating_light:
Ravi: error snippet in logs: `AccessDeniedException: User <role/snapshot-runner> is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999988887777:key/ef01-2345`
Priya: was there a key rotation overnight?
Ravi: yes, CMK ef01-2345 rotated at 00:45 UTC by rotation-runner.
Jordan: quick guess: rotation removed or retired grants that restore expects. Snapshot pipeline expects a grant for role/snapshot-runner to be present after rotation.
Priya: mitigation plan: create a short-lived grant for the uploader/restore role and resume the restore. avoid long-lived grants.
Jordan: command I used locally (adapt as needed):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id ef01-2345 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::999988887777:role/snapshot-runner --operations Decrypt,Encrypt
```
Priya: agreed. make TTL 8h and tag with `incident=customer88-restore`
ops-bot: suggestion: add automated check in rotation workflow to run a decrypt canary from snapshot-runner before retiring old grants
Nora: also we should add an alert rule: if any RetireGrant event removes the last grant for a key and there are snapshot restores or upload attempts in the past 72h, escalate to eng-security.
Ravi: creating temporary grant now. GrantId: g-9a8b7c6d returned. passing GrantToken to restore job.
Jordan: restore resumed at 03:23 UTC. monitoring logs for further decrypt errors.
Priya: infra note: rotation-runner is parallelized; race found where two workers might retire grants while another hasn't mirrored them. Needs idempotency + leader election.
Nora: opening ticket SEC-4987 "rotation-runner: ensure grant mirroring & idempotent retire" and assigned to infra oncall.
Ravi: short postmortem notes:
- Immediate: create TTL grant, resume restores, confirm integrity
- Short: add canary decrypt during rotation and detection alert for orphaned keys
- Medium: update rotation-runner to mirror grants first, verify decrypts, then retire old grants (two-phase commit style)
- Long: maintain a small transition role with persistent decrypt rights used only by restore workflows; gated by RBAC and audit logs
Jordan: also add metric enrichment: include GrantId/GrantToken stub and key alias in restore failure telemetry so triage is faster.
Priya: I'll draft a 1-page mapping of RBAC roles -> expected KMS grants and link with rotation-runner PR.
ops-bot: runbook-recommendation: before any CMK retire step, create mirrored grants and run decrypt test from restore role. Add rollback if test fails.
Ravi: restore finished successfully at 03:37 UTC. customer notified. closing once SEC-4987 has ETA.
Nora: SOC will add detection rule and choreography with support for customer notifications. :thumbsup:
